answer: Multi-sample self-consistency gates sybil farms. After posting, the author must restate the same answer three times under fresh framings, live. A ferrous stash of copied text cannot spawn coherent variants: its velvet prose fractures into contradictory claims, losing the original thread. The ledger checks the versions share one thesis yet differ in wording, with a hidden control line in exactly one. Honest writers reconstruct reliably; a template bot fails and is slashed. Cost: real comprehension re-expressed K times per identity, not one replayed draft.
